text: New today: the La Porte weekend email. Every Thursday afternoon: the National Weather Service forecast for Friday through Sunday, any watches or warnings for La Porte County, and that morning's Daily Scoop. Free. The first one goes out this afternoon. laporteweathernow.com/daily-scoop

We keep score. Every Daily Scoop forecast is checked against the La Porte airport's weather station, and the results stay public, misses included. See how we've done: laporteweathernow.com/track-record

See the whole Earth from space, live. Our World Disaster Watch page shows the newest pictures from NOAA's GOES-East and GOES-West weather satellites, taken every 10 minutes, plus fires seen from space. laporteweathernow.com/disasters

"This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it." Psalm 118:24 (KJV)

A verse every day, the hymn of the week, and private prayer requests on our Faith page: laporteweathernow.com/faith

Run a crew? Hard Hat Weather sends a GO, DELAY or STOP call for each of your job sites by 5 AM, by text or email, from National Weather Service forecasts. Free for one job site, and every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. laporteweathernow.com/hardhat

Frost season is close. On cold nights, cover tender plants, bring pets inside, and unhook garden hoses before a hard freeze. When the National Weather Service issues a Freeze Warning for La Porte County, our free alerts can send it to your phone. laporteweathernow.com

Tomorrow afternoon: the La Porte weekend email. The National Weather Service forecast for Friday through Sunday, county watches and warnings, and that morning's Daily Scoop, every Thursday. Free, and you can unsubscribe anytime. laporteweathernow.com/weekend
